# Hannah and Samuel (1 Samuel 1:28)

## Emotional Focus
When a family gives a child to God.

## Key KJV
“I have lent him to the LORD.” (1 Samuel 1:28)

## Gentle Retelling
Hannah prayed for a baby and promised him to God. When Samuel was born she kept her promise and brought him to the temple, but God blessed their family.

## Coloring Prompt
Hannah gently bringing young Samuel to the temple with a peaceful, trusting smile.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God takes care of the children we love and give to Him.”
